stances_toward.note: DP World runs Berbera port and the UAE got a 25-year lease for a base and the airport in 2017 (Crisis Group, 2018). Israel recognised Somaliland on 26 Dec 2025 and is reported to want a facility at Berbera, which Mogadishu rejects; the UAE signed neither the Arab-Islamic statement against the recognition nor any statement for it. Partner: transactional lease and port deal, no alignment on status. Bond none.

stances_toward.note: The MoU of 1 Jan 2024 - per the CRS a reported offer to recognise the self-declared republic in exchange for a coastal lease - made Hargeisa Ethiopia's route to a port and the cause of the 2024 break with Mogadishu. Since the Ankara Declaration Addis Ababa has not recognised Somaliland and has not buried the MoU; after Israel's recognition on 26 Dec 2025 it stayed silent (a Somaliland-aligned outlet reads that as strategic ambiguity, which we cannot confirm). The El Alamein quadrilateral of 4 Oct 2026 rejects any support for Somaliland and Mogadishu rejects an Israeli presence at Berbera. Partner: transactional, port and trade, no recognition; Berbera is also the UAE's base. Confidence C because the grade rests on one outlet's reading of silence. Bond none.
